root_cause_evidence: Earlier q95 12x109 L-BFGS-B optimization bound active-support ceilings and exact SWMM replay exposed false-beneficial optimized plans.
Historical V8 evidence nevertheless showed useful control directions and event-level TFV reductions versus No-control/EFD, so differentiability itself was not rejected.

A later receding-prefix V8 runtime executed 0/198 actions while 15/18 sampled rejected H10 plans were truly beneficial, demonstrating that near-all-HOLD behavior can be caused by overconservative admission rather than lack of controllability.
V11 exact target-latch replay remained only 11/15 sign-correct in sampled decisions and stronger events contained false-beneficial first moves.
V12 local target-latched H360 replay improved sign behavior but event-level repeated H10 control still failed to consistently beat No-control/competent rule baselines.
The earlier policy-return implementation labelled H10 first-action value while encoding a persistent H360 candidate and the old V14 proposal path still called the historical full-plan optimizer.
The current asset manifest had already removed V12 admissions while one bulk query runner still attempted to read them; that current/archival path split has now been removed.
current_response: Freeze Step1 and base Step2 V5 to preserve existing training investment until new evidence identifies representation failure.
Use base Step2 to batch-score +/- H10 probes over all 109 facilities and form full/half learned H10 directions plus one type-aware hydraulic-pressure direction.

Add exactly one 109-D H10-only support-constrained projected-gradient proposal so the controller retains continuous differentiable search capacity without restoring the historical 1308-D full-plan optimizer.
Project every gradient trial into physical bounds, 0.5 slew, per-facility q95 first-move radius and q95 changed-facility support before it becomes a candidate.
Contract every candidate to q95 joint-sequence support using the actual H10 pulse geometry.
Encode policy-return training/calibration/runtime as H10 candidate followed by H350 HOLD, matching the exact paired SWMM intervention.
Use a current hybrid Base-H10 pi0 with the same four-family proposal geometry for first-round paired labels; historical V12 is archival only.
Rank/admit all distinct candidates with the receding-policy-return critic and rainfall-group one-sided conformal upper bound; HOLD only when every calibrated upper bound is nonnegative.
If pi1 materially changes the state/action distribution, collect a new role-disjoint Q^pi1 round before Policy Lock.

hard_rules: sole online optimization objective is system-wide cumulative TFV
Priority8 PFV is an authoritative secondary non-inferiority safety condition: proposed <= 100 m3 + 1.05 * no_control unless a later preregistered contract changes it
Global Peak remains report-only
all 109 writable facilities are screened; no hand-picked small actuator subset is assumed
the projected-gradient proposer optimizes only the current 109-D H10 first action and never a 12x109 full plan
projected-gradient base Step2 score cannot itself authorize execution; final execution is controlled only by the matched policy-return critic/admission
actuator bounds, 0.5 target slew, q95 first-move density support and q95 joint-sequence support remain canonical
HOLD means latch the previous supervisory target
unchanged facilities retain previous commanded targets exactly
score equals execute; no material post-score projection is allowed
policy-return action encoding is H10 candidate then H350 HOLD; persistent H360 candidate encoding is forbidden
candidate and HOLD authoritative branches share the same raw causal prefix and same frozen continuation policy after H10
future realised rainfall, future SWMM state/flooding, future Internal trajectory and online SWMM candidate search are forbidden

current execution may not require historical V12 policy/first-move admission files or silently fall back to a historical V* path

production and untouched evaluation remain fail-closed
